title: Supply span of a straight-tip catheter refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program
content:
On the Urology and Continence Supply Program, this rule concerns a straight-tip intermittent catheter (A4351) refill on the Continence Original Medicare Program. For a straight-tip intermittent catheter refill on the Original Medicare tier, and only for such a refill, the supply days of the refill are set by the supply-span rule of this policy; every other refill keeps the base supply days.

## Rule

The newest grant is the program's straight-tip authorization grant with the latest valid-from date. When no such grant is on file, the refill has no supply days.

1. **Grant ending early.** When the valid-through date of the newest grant is fewer than the standard supply days after the ship date, the supply days are replaced by the whole 30-day blocks from the ship date to that valid-through date.
2. **Alignment with an ostomy refill.** Otherwise, the customer may hold an Ostomy Supply Program in active status. Take the supply end of the latest ostomy refill shipped to the customer, which is its ship date plus its supply days. When that supply end falls at least 30 and fewer than the standard supply days after the ship date, the supply days are replaced by the whole 30-day blocks from the ship date to that ostomy supply end, so that both refills fall due together.
3. **Otherwise** the supply days stay the standard supply days.

The standard supply days are the tier's standard supply per shipment, which is 90 days on the Continence Original Medicare Program. "Whole 30-day blocks" means the calendar days counted from the ship date, divided by 30 and rounded down, then taken as that many 30-day blocks.

## Records read

- the program's straight-tip authorization grants, with their valid-from and valid-through dates;
- the status of the customer's Ostomy Supply Program;
- the ship date and supply days of the latest ostomy refill shipped to the customer.

## Decision table (hypothetical days counted from the ship date)

| Newest grant valid through | Ostomy Supply Program active? | Latest ostomy supply end | Supply days |
|---|---|---|---|
| day 75 | any | any | 60, because day 75 gives two whole blocks |
| day 89 | any | any | 60 |
| day 90 | yes | day 64 | 60, aligned with the ostomy supply end |
| day 200 | yes | day 30 | 30: the end is at least 30 days ahead |
| day 200 | yes | day 29 | 90: the end is fewer than 30 days ahead |
| day 200 | yes | day 90 | 90: the end is not fewer than 90 days ahead |
| day 200 | no | day 64 | 90 |
| no grant on file | any | any | none |
